items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: We were never friends after that. I wouldn't take Willie nowhere with me.

ctx.x: I said, 'Why are you making this noise?' And so he says, 'Well, ask Willie where he lives.' And Willie didn't know nothing. I says where I live, on 2219 E Street, and I know you catch the F train when you go home and that's where I live and I can get home, if I could get -- let me take him home. So then they went and got my mother and Willie went into his act until they give Willie a whole lot of ice cream. We were never friends after that. I wouldn't take Willie nowhere with me.
